verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a broad REST API and SDK for automating projects, deployments, domains, and account resources, with a published OpenAPI spec and scoped access tokens. The CLI also covers dashboard-style operations such as logs, certificates, DNS, and per-function region settings. However, no evidence states that the API matches everything the dashboard UI can do, so full UI parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim or coverage matrix, evidence that UI-only features (e.g. toolbar comments, marketplace installs, billing/team settings) are exposed via API, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Automate projects, deployments, domains, and account resources through the Vercel REST API or SDK.
Interact programmatically with your Vercel account using the SDK or direct HTTP requests.

With the command-line interface (CLI) you can interact with the Vercel platform using a terminal, or through an automated system, enabling you to retrieve logs, manage certificates, replicate your deployment environment locally, manage Domain Name System (DNS) records, and more.
Vercel access tokens authenticate requests to the Vercel REST API and the Vercel CLI on your behalf.
